question: Which of the following best describes the cultural significance of "Mim" in the "Mim Kut festival"?
option_1: A rare millet stored for famine
option_2: The sacred herb for tribal healing
option_3: The last harvest representing survival and love
option_4: A mythological offering for spirits only
solution_text:
The correct answer is The last harvest representing survival and love.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Mim Kut is a harvest festival celebrated by the Mizo people (particularly the Hmar community) of Mizoram, observed after the maize (Mim/मिम) harvest is gathered.

• The festival commemorates the dead and celebrates the last harvest, symbolising survival, remembrance and love for departed family members.

• Offerings of the first fruits and rice-beer are made to the spirits of the deceased during the festivities.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• Mizoram's major festivals include Chapchar Kut, Mim Kut and Pawl Kut, all linked to the agricultural cycle.

• Chapchar Kut is a spring festival celebrated before the jhum (shifting cultivation) sowing season.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): A rare millet stored for famine — incorrect; Mim refers to maize as a harvest symbol, not a famine-storage millet.

• opt (Option 2): The sacred herb for tribal healing — incorrect; Mim is not a medicinal herb.

• opt (Option 4): A mythological offering for spirits only — incorrect; while offerings are made, Mim itself signifies the harvest of survival and love, not merely a spirit offering.

question: The Kharchi Puja of Tripura is associated with worship of how many deities?
solution_text:
The correct answer is 14.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Kharchi Puja is a week-long Hindu festival celebrated in Tripura dedicated to the worship of the fourteen deities called Chaturdasha Devata (चतुर्दश देवता).

• The festival is held in the Agartala region and is one of the most important festivals of the state, drawing large crowds.

• 'Khar' means sin and 'chi' means cleaning, so Kharchi Puja signifies the worship performed to cleanse the sins of the people.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Additional Information

• The fourteen gods are worshipped at the Chaturdasha Devata temple at Old Agartala.

• The deities were traditionally worshipped by the royal family of the Tripura (Manikya) dynasty.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): 12 — incorrect; the number of deities worshipped is fourteen, not twelve.

• opt (Option 3): 15 — incorrect.

• opt (Option 4): 16 — incorrect.

question:
Consider the following statements about Mughal architecture:
1.Mughal architecture is known for blending Persian, Islamic, Turkish, and Indian styles to create a unique Indo-Islamic aesthetic.
2.Red sandstone and white marble were the two most commonly used materials in Mughal construction.
solution_text:
The correct answer is Both 1 and 2 are correct.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Mughal architecture (मुगल वास्तुकला) is a fusion of Persian, Islamic, Turkish and indigenous Indian styles, producing the distinctive Indo-Islamic aesthetic seen in monuments like the Taj Mahal.

• Red sandstone and white marble were the two most widely used building materials, with red sandstone dominant in early works and marble in later, more refined structures.

• Features include large domes, slender minarets, arches, pietra dura inlay and symmetrical charbagh gardens.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• Fatehpur Sikri and the Agra Fort make extensive use of red sandstone.

• The Taj Mahal and Moti Masjid exemplify the white-marble phase under Shah Jahan.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Only 1 is correct — incorrect; statement 2 about materials is also true.

• opt (Option 2): Only 2 is correct — incorrect; statement 1 about style-blending is also true.

• opt (Option 4): Neither 1 nor 2 is correct — incorrect; both statements are accurate.

question: Which of the following is a correct statement regarding violations in basketball?
option_1: A player may stay in the restricted area for 5 seconds.
option_2: A team must shoot the ball within 8 seconds of play.
option_3: A dribble ends when both hands touch the ball once.
option_4: A player remains in play while standing on sideline.
solution_text:
The correct answer is A dribble ends when both hands touch the ball once.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• In basketball, a dribble ends the moment a player touches the ball simultaneously with both hands or lets it come to rest in one or both hands (द्विकर स्पर्श से ड्रिबल समाप्त).

• Touching the ball with both hands is a legal way to stop a dribble, but restarting the dribble afterward is a 'double dribble' violation.

• A dribble is the act of bouncing the ball with one hand while moving or standing.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• The restricted (key/paint) area allows an offensive player only 3 seconds, not 5.

• Under FIBA rules a team has 24 seconds (not 8) to attempt a shot, and 8 seconds only to cross into the frontcourt.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): A player may stay in the restricted area for 5 seconds — incorrect; the limit is 3 seconds.

• opt (Option 2): A team must shoot the ball within 8 seconds of play — incorrect; the shot-clock is 24 seconds, 8 seconds is the backcourt limit.

• opt (Option 4): A player remains in play while standing on sideline — incorrect; stepping on or beyond the sideline is out of bounds.

question: Which sports player won the bronze medal in the Mixed Team Compound Open Archery event at the Paris 2024 Paralympics?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Sheetal Devi and Rakesh Kumar.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• At the Paris 2024 Paralympics, the Indian pair of Sheetal Devi and Rakesh Kumar won the bronze medal in the Mixed Team Compound Open archery event (मिश्रित टीम कंपाउंड ओपन तीरंदाजी).

• Sheetal Devi, born without arms, shoots using her feet and is one of the most celebrated para-archers in the world.

• They defeated the Italian pair in the bronze-medal match.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Additional Information

• Harvinder Singh won India's first-ever Paralympic gold in archery (men's individual recurve) at Paris 2024.

• India recorded its best-ever medal haul of 29 medals at the Paris 2024 Paralympics.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Harvinder Singh and Jyoti Baliyan — incorrect; this pair did not win the compound mixed bronze.

• opt (Option 3): Sheetal Devi and Harvinder Singh — incorrect; Harvinder is a recurve archer.

• opt (Option 4): Rakesh Kumar and Vivek Chikara — incorrect pairing.

question: Where was the Americas Regional Office of the New Development Bank (NDB) announced to be established during the BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting in 2018?
solution_text:
The correct answer is São Paulo.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The New Development Bank (NDB), the BRICS bank, has its headquarters in Shanghai, China, with its Americas Regional Office established in São Paulo, Brazil (साओ पाउलो).

• The regional office arrangement was highlighted during BRICS meetings in 2018, extending the bank's reach in the Americas.

• The NDB was established in 2015 to fund infrastructure and sustainable development projects in BRICS and other emerging economies.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• The NDB's first President was K. V. Kamath of India.

• The bank also has regional offices/centres in Johannesburg (Africa) and Moscow (Eurasia).

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Mexico City — incorrect; not the Americas regional office location.

• opt (Option 2): Buenos Aires — incorrect.

• opt (Option 4): Lima — incorrect.

question: Which of the following statements best captures the essence of the book Because Words Matter?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Language's role in social justice.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The book 'Because Words Matter' centres on how language shapes, reflects and can advance social justice and inclusion (सामाजिक न्याय में भाषा की भूमिका).

• It underscores that the words we choose have power to include or exclude, and to influence fairness and equity in society.

• The work stresses conscious and responsible use of language as a tool for positive social change.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

• Such works fall within the field of sociolinguistics, which studies the relationship between language and society.

• Language sensitivity and inclusive vocabulary are increasingly emphasised in law, media and governance.

NOTE

• opt (Option 2): Ancient Sanskrit grammar — incorrect; the book is not about classical grammar.

• opt (Option 3): Novel on colonial India — incorrect; it is not a work of colonial fiction.

• opt (Option 4): Linguist's critique of post-colonial English — incorrect; that is not the book's core theme.

question: Which of the following statements about rockslide is correct?
option_1: It affects only the outermost layer of the rock face
option_2: It is slower than rock fall
option_3: It involves backward rotation of debris
option_4: It affects material to considerable depth
solution_text:
The correct answer is It affects material to considerable depth.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• A rockslide is a type of mass movement in which a large mass of rock slides down a slope along a plane of weakness, affecting material to a considerable depth (चट्टान-स्खलन गहराई तक प्रभावित करता है).

• Unlike surface weathering, a rockslide dislodges deep-seated blocks of bedrock along bedding planes, joints or fault surfaces.

• It is generally rapid and can cause large-scale landscape change and damage.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

Additional Information

• Rockslides are common in the Himalayas and other young fold-mountain regions with steep, jointed slopes.

• Slumps involve backward rotation of debris along a curved surface, which is a different process.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): It affects only the outermost layer of the rock face — incorrect; rockslides affect deep material.

• opt (Option 2): It is slower than rock fall — incorrect; rockslides are rapid mass movements.

• opt (Option 3): It involves backward rotation of debris — incorrect; that describes a slump, not a rockslide.

question: What correctly describes Neeraj Chopra's performance at the Paris Diamond League 2025?
option_1: He secured victory with his third throw measuring 88.16m at Stade de France.
option_2: His only valid attempt, 88.16m, came in the final round.
option_3: He won with his opening throw of 88.16m at Stade Sébastien Charléty.
option_4: He placed second with a best throw of 88.16m.
solution_text:
The correct answer is He won with his opening throw of 88.16m at Stade Sébastien Charléty.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• At the Paris Diamond League 2025, Neeraj Chopra won the men's javelin title with a first-round (opening) throw of 88.16m at Stade Sébastien Charléty (स्टेड सेबेस्टियन चार्लेटी में पहली थ्रो से जीत).

• This dominant opening effort proved to be the winning distance, ahead of Germany's Julian Weber.

• It marked Neeraj's first major title win of the 2025 season.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• Neeraj Chopra is India's Olympic gold medallist (Tokyo 2020) and World Champion (Budapest 2023) in javelin.

• He is a multiple Diamond League podium finisher and won the Diamond League final in 2022.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Third throw at Stade de France — incorrect; it was his opening throw and the venue was Stade Sébastien Charléty.

• opt (Option 2): Only valid attempt in the final round — incorrect; the winning throw came in the first round.

• opt (Option 4): He placed second — incorrect; Neeraj won the event.

question: Following a significant change in leadership at India's premier space agency, which distinguished scientist was appointed as the new Chairman of ISRO and Secretary of the Department of Space in January 2025, succeeding S. Somanath?
solution_text:
The correct answer is V. Narayanan.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• V. Narayanan took charge as the Chairman of ISRO and Secretary, Department of Space, in January 2025, succeeding S. Somanath (वी. नारायणन इसरो के नए अध्यक्ष).

• He is a distinguished rocket and space propulsion expert who earlier headed the Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC).

• His appointment was approved by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• ISRO's headquarters is at Bengaluru, Karnataka.

• S. Somanath led ISRO during the successful Chandrayaan-3 and Aditya-L1 missions.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): K Radhakrishnan — incorrect; he was an earlier ISRO Chairman (2009–2014).

• opt (Option 2): K. Sivan — incorrect; he was ISRO Chairman (2018–2022).

• opt (Option 4): S. Sashidhar Sinha — incorrect; not the appointee.

question:
Which of the following statements about dams is/are correct?
1.A dam always refers to a concrete or structural wall built to block water.
2.Spillways in dams help in regulating water flow, either intermittently or continuously.
3.Dams can be classified based on structure, purpose, and height.
solution_text:
The correct answer is Both 2 and 3.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Spillways are structures that safely release surplus water from a reservoir, regulating flow either intermittently or continuously (स्पिलवे जल प्रवाह को नियंत्रित करते हैं) — statement 2 is correct.

• Dams are classified on the basis of structure (gravity, arch, buttress, embankment), purpose (storage, diversion, detention) and height — statement 3 is correct.

• Statement 1 is wrong because a dam is not always a concrete/structural wall; many dams are embankment (earth/rock-fill) dams.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Additional Information

• The Tehri Dam is a tall embankment (earth and rock-fill) dam, while the Bhakra Dam is a concrete gravity dam.

• Spillways prevent overtopping and structural failure during floods.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Both 1 and 2 — incorrect; statement 1 is false.

• opt (Option 3): Both 1 and 3 — incorrect; statement 1 is false.

• opt (Option 4): 1, 2 and 3 all are correct — incorrect; statement 1 is false.

question: Aditya-L1 spacecraft primarily studies which part of the Sun?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Corona.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Aditya-L1, India's first dedicated solar mission, primarily studies the Sun's outer atmosphere, the corona (सूर्य का कोरोना), along with the photosphere and chromosphere.

• It is placed in a halo orbit around the Sun-Earth Lagrange point L1, about 1.5 million km from Earth, giving a continuous, unobstructed view of the Sun.

• A key aim is to understand coronal heating, solar wind and coronal mass ejections.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Additional Information

• Aditya-L1 was launched by ISRO on 2 September 2023 aboard PSLV-C57.

• It carries seven payloads, including the Visible Emission Line Coronagraph (VELC).

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Regolith — incorrect; regolith refers to loose surface material on the Moon/planets, not the Sun.

• opt (Option 3): Craters — incorrect; the Sun is a gaseous body without craters.

• opt (Option 4): Magnetosphere — incorrect; while it studies solar wind, the primary focus is the corona.

question: Which group consists of non-ferrous metallic minerals that are scarce in India?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Copper, Zinc, Lead.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Copper, zinc and lead are non-ferrous metallic minerals (they do not contain iron) that are scarce/deficient in India (तांबा, जस्ता, सीसा अलौह धातु खनिज).

• India imports large quantities of copper ore concentrate to meet its industrial demand.

• Non-ferrous metals are vital for electrical, alloy, battery and galvanising industries.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Additional Information

• Zinc and lead are mainly mined at Rajpura-Dariba and Zawar in Rajasthan.

• Copper is chiefly obtained from Khetri (Rajasthan), Malanjkhand (Madhya Pradesh) and Singhbhum (Jharkhand).

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Iron, Coal, Bauxite — incorrect; iron is ferrous, coal is non-metallic, and all are abundant in India.

• opt (Option 3): Manganese, Bauxite, Limestone — incorrect; these are relatively abundant and not all non-ferrous metals.

• opt (Option 4): Mica, Dolomite, Felspar — incorrect; these are non-metallic minerals.

question:
Fill in the blanks:
Zonal Councils were created by the _______ Act, 1956.
solution_text:
The correct answer is States Reorganisation.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The five Zonal Councils were set up under the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 (राज्य पुनर्गठन अधिनियम, 1956), to promote inter-state cooperation and coordination.

• They are statutory (not constitutional) bodies designed to foster emotional integration and resolve inter-state disputes.

• The Union Home Minister is the common chairman of all Zonal Councils.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

• The five zones are Northern, Central, Eastern, Western and Southern.

• A separate North-Eastern Council was created later, in 1971, by a distinct Act.

NOTE

• opt (Option 2): Finance Commission — incorrect; the Finance Commission is a constitutional body under Article 280.

• opt (Option 3): Panchayati Raj — incorrect; related to local self-government (73rd Amendment).

• opt (Option 4): Representation of People — incorrect; that Act deals with elections.

question: Which of the following statements regarding the distribution of legislative powers between the Union and State legislatures is correct?
option_1: The State legislature can legislate on matters enumerated in the Union List
option_2: The Union legislature can legislate on matters in the Concurrent List only with State approval
option_3: The Union Government can issue directions to the States under Article 256
option_4: The Union and States have equal powers on matters in the Union List
solution_text:
The correct answer is The Union Government can issue directions to the States under Article 256.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Article 256 provides that the executive power of every State shall be so exercised as to ensure compliance with laws made by Parliament, and the Union may give such directions to States as appear necessary (अनुच्छेद 256 के तहत केंद्र राज्यों को निर्देश दे सकता है).

• The Seventh Schedule divides legislative powers into the Union List, State List and Concurrent List.

• Only Parliament can legislate on the Union List, and it can legislate on the Concurrent List without requiring State approval.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• In case of conflict on a Concurrent List subject, the Union law prevails (Article 254).

• Parliament can legislate on State List subjects under special circumstances (Articles 249, 250, 252, 253).

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): State legislature can legislate on the Union List — incorrect; only the Union can.

• opt (Option 2): Union can legislate on Concurrent List only with State approval — incorrect; no State approval is needed.

• opt (Option 4): Union and States have equal powers on the Union List — incorrect; the Union alone has power over the Union List.

question:
Read the following statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct option:
Assertion (A): The PSLV-C59 mission, launched in October 2024, achieved a notable milestone for international space cooperation.
Reason (R): This mission successfully deployed the Proba-3 satellites, marking the first dedicated satellite launch for ESA's unique formation-flying experiment.
option_1: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
option_2: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
option_3: A is true, but R is false
option_4: A is false, but R is true
solution_text:
The correct answer is Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The PSLV-C59 mission was an ISRO commercial launch that successfully placed ESA's Proba-3 satellites into orbit, a landmark in international space cooperation (अंतरराष्ट्रीय अंतरिक्ष सहयोग).

• Proba-3 is the world's first precision formation-flying mission, using two satellites to create an artificial solar eclipse to study the Sun's corona.

• Thus the successful Proba-3 deployment (R) directly explains why the mission was a notable milestone for international cooperation (A).

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

• PSLV-C59/Proba-3 was launched from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota.

• The mission was executed by NSIL (NewSpace India Limited), ISRO's commercial arm, for ESA.

NOTE

• opt (Option 2): Both true but R not the correct explanation — incorrect; R does explain A.

• opt (Option 3): A true, R false — incorrect; R is true.

• opt (Option 4): A false, R true — incorrect; A is treated as true in the official key.

question: Bharatiya Nagarik suraksha Samhita(BNSS) ensures access to FIR through which portal?
solution_text:
The correct answer is CCTNS.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023 leverages the Crime and Criminal Tracking Network and Systems (CCTNS) portal (सीसीटीएनएस) to make FIRs digitally accessible.

• CCTNS is a nationwide network connecting police stations to enable electronic registration, storage and retrieval of crime and criminal records.

• It promotes transparency and citizen access to FIR information.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Additional Information

• BNSS replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), 1973, and came into effect on 1 July 2024.

• CCTNS is implemented by the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB).

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): National Crime Portal — incorrect; not the designated FIR-access platform under BNSS.

• opt (Option 3): BHAVISHYA — incorrect; it is a pension-tracking portal for central government pensioners.

• opt (Option 4): DIGI-FIR — incorrect; not the recognised portal for this purpose.

question:
Which of the following pairs of Government Scheme and its associated Nodal Ministry/Department is correctly matched?
1. PM-AASHA – Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
2. e-NAM – Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
3. PMKSY – Ministry of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation
4. RODTEP – Ministry of Finance
solution_text:
The correct answer is 2 only.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• e-NAM (National Agriculture Market) is implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (कृषि एवं किसान कल्याण मंत्रालय) — pair 2 is correctly matched.

• PM-AASHA is also under the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, not the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, so pair 1 is wrong.

• RODTEP (Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products) is administered by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, not the Ministry of Finance, so pair 4 is wrong.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• PMKSY (Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana) is coordinated primarily by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (Jal Shakti and Rural Development handle components), making pair 3 as stated inexact.

• e-NAM links agricultural produce market committees (APMCs) into a single online trading platform.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): 1 and 2 only — incorrect; pair 1 (PM-AASHA) is wrongly matched.

• opt (Option 2): 2 and 3 only — incorrect; pair 3 as stated is not correctly matched.

• opt (Option 4): 1, 2 and 4 — incorrect; pairs 1 and 4 are wrongly matched.

question:
Fill in the Blank:
Panthi dance is linked to the followers of _____ in Chhattisgarh.
solution_text:
The correct answer is Guru Ghasidas.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Panthi is a devotional folk dance of Chhattisgarh performed by the Satnami community, the followers of Guru Ghasidas (गुरु घासीदास).

• It is performed on Guru Ghasidas Jayanti (Maghi Purnima) around a 'jaitkham' (a white pillar), reflecting deep spiritual devotion.

• The dance combines fast rhythmic movements with songs praising the guru and conveying the Satnam philosophy.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

• Guru Ghasidas founded the Satnam Panth, preaching equality and the worship of one formless God (Satnam).

• Other famous folk dances of Chhattisgarh include Raut Nacha, Karma and Saila.

NOTE

• opt (Option 2): Kabir — incorrect; Panthi is tied to Guru Ghasidas's Satnami followers, not Kabir Panth.

• opt (Option 3): Kabuli — incorrect; not associated with Panthi dance.

• opt (Option 4): Nanak — incorrect; Guru Nanak founded Sikhism, unrelated to Panthi dance.

question: According to the 2024 Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) findings, how does corruption most directly undermine global climate action?
option_1: By weakening financial markets in developing countries
option_2: By discouraging public participation in environmental protests
option_3: By diverting climate funds and allowing undue influence over environmental policies
option_4: By increasing competition among fossil fuel companies
solution_text:
The correct answer is By diverting climate funds and allowing undue influence over environmental policies.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The 2024 Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) by Transparency International specifically highlighted how corruption undermines climate action by diverting climate funds and enabling undue influence over environmental policy-making (जलवायु निधियों का दुरुपयोग और नीतियों पर अनुचित प्रभाव).

• Misallocation of climate finance weakens mitigation and adaptation efforts, especially in vulnerable nations.

• Undue influence lets vested interests dilute or block strong environmental regulations.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• The CPI ranks 180 countries and territories on perceived public-sector corruption on a scale of 0 (highly corrupt) to 100 (very clean).

• Denmark has consistently topped the CPI as the least corrupt country.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Weakening financial markets — incorrect; not the CPI's stated primary link to climate action.

• opt (Option 2): Discouraging public participation in protests — incorrect; not the highlighted mechanism.

• opt (Option 4): Increasing competition among fossil fuel companies — incorrect; corruption undermines, not fosters, healthy competition.

question: Objective of India's new Eco-Tourism Policy in protected areas?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Balance conservation and livelihoods.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• India's Eco-Tourism Policy for protected areas aims to strike a balance between conservation of nature and the livelihoods of local communities (संरक्षण और आजीविका में संतुलन).

• It promotes low-impact, community-based, sustainable tourism that generates income while protecting biodiversity.

• Local participation and benefit-sharing are central to the policy's design.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

Additional Information

• Eco-tourism encourages responsible travel to natural areas that conserves the environment and improves the well-being of local people.

• Protected areas in India include national parks, wildlife sanctuaries, biosphere reserves and conservation reserves.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Ban human activity — incorrect; the policy regulates, not fully bans, activity.

• opt (Option 2): Maximize profit w/o community — incorrect; community involvement is essential.

• opt (Option 4): Turn areas into resorts — incorrect; commercialisation into resorts is contrary to eco-tourism aims.

question:
Which of the following statements about the sugar industry is/are correct?
1. Sugarcane's sucrose content decreases during transportation.
2. Sugar industry is seasonal in nature.
3. The industry is unsuitable for cooperative management.
4. Major sugar-producing states include Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu.
solution_text:
The correct answer is Only 1, 2 and 4.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Sucrose content in sugarcane falls once it is cut, so delays in transport reduce sugar recovery (परिवहन के दौरान सुक्रोज की मात्रा घटती है) — statement 1 is correct.

• The sugar industry is seasonal because it operates during the cane crushing season — statement 2 is correct.

• Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu are among the major sugar-producing states — statement 4 is correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Additional Information

• The sugar industry in India is very well suited to the cooperative sector, especially in Maharashtra, so statement 3 is false.

• India is one of the largest producers and consumers of sugar in the world.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): Only 1 and 3 — incorrect; statement 3 is false and statements 2 and 4 are omitted.

• opt (Option 3): Only 2, 3 and 4 — incorrect; statement 3 is false.

• opt (Option 4): Only 1 and 4 — incorrect; it omits the correct statement 2.

question:
Which of the following statements correctly describe the MISHTI initiative launched in India?
1. The MISHTI programme is designed to increase mangrove forest cover and enhance livelihood opportunities in coastal areas.
2. It is a project initiated under the Ministry of Rural Development.
3. The program is financed with a mix of fundings coming from the CAMPA (Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority) Fund and the MGNREGS (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme).
solution_text:
The correct answer is 1 and 3.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• MISHTI (Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats & Tangible Incomes) aims to increase mangrove cover and generate livelihoods in coastal areas (मैंग्रोव वन क्षेत्र बढ़ाना और आजीविका) — statement 1 is correct.

• It is financed through a convergence of MGNREGS, the CAMPA Fund and other sources — statement 2 (financing) is correct.

• It is implemented under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, not the Ministry of Rural Development, so statement 2 (ministry) is false.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Additional Information

• MISHTI was announced in the Union Budget 2023-24.

• It seeks to restore and develop mangroves along India's coastline and on salt-pan lands.

NOTE

• opt (Option 1): 1 and 2 — incorrect; statement 2 wrongly names the Ministry of Rural Development.

• opt (Option 3): 2 and 3 — incorrect; statement 2 is false.

question:
Which of the following statements are correct?
1. Kalbelia performers rarely document their art due to its oral nomadic heritage.
2. Costumes avoid stitched elements in honor of serpent rituals.
3. The community's art was included in UNESCO ICH list without any written application process.
solution_text:
The correct answer is Only 1.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The Kalbelia community of Rajasthan has a nomadic, oral tradition, so their art is rarely documented in writing (मौखिक खानाबदोश विरासत) — statement 1 is correct.

• Kalbelia costumes are richly decorated and heavily stitched/embroidered with mirror work, so statement 2 is false.

• The Kalbelia dance was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2010 through a formal, documented nomination process, so statement 3 is false.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

• Kalbelia dance is performed by women in swirling black skirts, imitating the movements of a serpent.

• The Kalbelia were traditionally snake charmers, and their songs and dances reflect this heritage.

NOTE

• opt (Option 2): Only 2 & 3 — incorrect; both statements 2 and 3 are false.

• opt (Option 3): All 1, 2 & 3 — incorrect; statements 2 and 3 are false.

• opt (Option 4): Only 1 & 3 — incorrect; statement 3 is false.

question:
Consider the following statements:
1. Every Money Bill is a Financial Bill.
2. Every Financial Bill is a Money Bill.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
solution_text:
The correct answer is Only 1.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Every Money Bill is a Financial Bill because Money Bills deal with financial matters, so statement 1 is correct (प्रत्येक धन विधेयक एक वित्तीय विधेयक होता है).

• However, every Financial Bill is NOT a Money Bill; a Money Bill deals only with matters specified in Article 110, so statement 2 is false.

• A Money Bill is certified as such by the Speaker of the Lok Sabha and can be introduced only in the Lok Sabha.

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

• Financial Bills are of two kinds — Category I (Article 117(1)) and Category II (Article 117(3)).

• The Rajya Sabha can only recommend changes to a Money Bill and must return it within 14 days; its recommendations are not binding on the Lok Sabha.

NOTE

• opt (Option 2): Only 2 — incorrect; statement 2 is false as not every Financial Bill is a Money Bill.

• opt (Option 3): Both 1 and 2 — incorrect; statement 2 is false.

• opt (Option 4): Neither 1 nor 2 — incorrect; statement 1 is true.
